info.title: NISAR Surface Change Explorer API
info.summary: Read-only access to NISAR radar measurements, study sites, stories with labelled hypotheses, shareable findings, the NASA catalog, soil moisture and height profiles.
info.description: All endpoints are public, need no key and return JSON. They are rate-limited per IP (limits are listed on each operation). Dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`; bounding boxes are `min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat` in WGS84 degrees. NISAR products are PROVISIONAL until NASA finishes reprocessing.

tags.name: Sites
tags.description: Curated study sites, each with a year of NISAR measurements and one map image per pass.

tags.name: Stories & findings
tags.description: Curated stories with labelled physical hypotheses, the evidence card behind each story (with its limits, a printable brief and CSV export), and a coverage check that says whether NISAR can answer a question over any area.

tags.name: Change types
tags.description: The kinds of surface change the platform tracks, and the metric each one is measured by.

tags.name: Evidence
tags.description: A study site's NISAR story: its series, the moments that sum it up, and related physical series (rain, river flow) on the same dates, for comparison only.

tags.name: Areas
tags.description: Rain for any rectangle you draw, over a date range.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Live search of NASA's Common Metadata Repository (CMR) for NISAR granules.

tags.name: Soil moisture
tags.description: Render a NISAR Level-3 soil-moisture (SME2) pass over an area.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Ground motion along a line, over NISAR's full interferogram record. Runs as a background job.

tags.name: Land change
tags.description: A gallery of places where NISAR saw change, with every pass on one track.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Health, scene images and the shared tool registry used by the MCP server (on by default) and the AI assistant (off by default).

tags.name: Assistant
tags.description: The AI assistant that answers questions with the platform's own tools and docs.

get.description: Every curated study site, alphabetically, with its change type, product, pass count and date range.

parameters.name: change_type
parameters.description: Only sites of this change type (see `/api/change-types`).

get.summary: Get one site with its time series
get.description: A site with every measured value (`observations`) and one map image per pass (`scenes`). Each scene names the NISAR granule it came from.
Each change type with its colour, NISAR product, image legend and the metrics it is measured by (id, label, unit, description).

The NISAR series for a site, the moments that sum it up, and related physical series (rain, river flow, earthquakes) summarised over the window before each pass. Open water is compared over the area every pass imaged (`footprint`). Shown for comparison only: lining up in time doesn't show that one affects the other.

window_days.description: Days before each pass that a driver is summed or averaged over.

radar.description: The NISAR series the drivers are compared with.

items.description: One driver: id, label, note, series (daily), per_pass values (summarised over the window before each pass).

moments.description: Notable passes with a short explanation.

footprint.description: For open-water series: the share of the box every pass imaged (`pct_of_box`), `status` (`ok` or `insufficient`), `method` (`exact` from HDF5 masks, or `image` calibrated from the scene images, with `uncertainty_pp` on the `estimated` passes) and `image_url`, an overlay hatching the area left out.

get.description: Daily rain (a weather model's estimate at the area's centre) between two dates, for comparing with NISAR passes over the area.
The NISAR products the catalog search understands, with their CMR collections and what each is for.
Granules of one product that intersect a box between two dates, newest first, with footprints, browse images and HDF5 download links. Proxied and cached from NASA CMR.

get.summary: Products with data over a box
get.description: How many granules of each NISAR product cover a box between two dates, so a client can offer only the products that have data there. A product whose search failed is `null`.

get.summary: Exact bounds of a browse image
get.description: Reads a granule's browse KML (from `browse_kml_url` in a granule search) and returns the box the browse image covers, for drawing it on a map.

parameters.name: kml
parameters.description: A granule's `browse_kml_url` (must be a NASA Earthdata URL).

get.description: Reads one SME2 granule over an area (up to 30° per side) and returns its date, quality, median values (`hh_db`, `hv_db`, `water_pct`, `soil_moisture` in m³/m³) and image URLs per layer. The first request for a granule and area takes ~5–15 s; later ones are cached. Needs the server to have an Earthdata token.

parameters.name: granule
parameters.description: SME2 granule name, from a catalog search with `product=SME2`.

images.description: Image URL per layer: backscatter, soil_moisture (cover the whole frame).

values.description: Median hh_db, hv_db, water_pct and soil_moisture (m³/m³) inside the area.

503.description: The server has no Earthdata token, so it cannot read SME2.

post.description: Starts (or finds the cached result of) a background job that measures ground motion along a line, up to 100 km, over the full GUNW record of the track that covers it best. Poll `GET /api/nisar/profiles/{id}`. A new line takes minutes; the same line again is instant.

get.description: Places where NISAR saw change (volcanoes, glaciers, floods, landslides, fires, construction), each with every GCOV pass on one track and frame so images line up. Each pass has a false-colour `image_url` and an 8-bit HH layer (`hh_url`) for computing change maps in the browser.

db_range.description: The dB range the 8-bit HH layers map to.

items.description: slug, name, kind, region, headline, story, look_for, bbox, frame, pixel_m, passes, sources.

get.description: Liveness, database connectivity, site count and when the data loader last ran.
The shared tool registry: every tool the MCP server and the AI assistant can call, with its JSON Schema. The MCP server lists exactly these.

post.description: Runs one tool with JSON arguments and returns its result, exactly as an MCP client or the assistant would see it.

get.description: Whether the assistant is configured on this server, and which model it uses.

post.description: Sends the conversation and the page context; the reply streams back as Server-Sent Events: `text` (a piece of the answer), `tool` (a tool call and its result summary), `action` (a suggested UI action such as opening the workspace), `error`, and `done`.
post.x-rate-limit: 10 per minute, plus a daily cap

context.description: Where the user is: `page` (path and title) and `workspace` (selected site, date, area).

messages.content: Why is HV backscatter higher over rice in August?

429.description: Rate limit or daily cap reached.

503.description: The assistant is not configured on this server.

get.description: A map image (WebP) for one pass, as linked from `scenes[].image_url` or the land-change gallery.

A profile job's state (`queued`, `running`, `done`, `error`) and, when done, its `result`: terrain height and line-of-sight displacement (mm, + toward the satellite) at every point and date, with the corrections applied.

The themes and every story with its question. Each story also names its place (`name`) and one of that place's own NISAR passes to picture it (`thumb_url`, a path under `/api/scenes`, and `thumb_date`). The list also holds auto-detected stories (`origin: "auto"`): templated, numbers-only changes the daily NISAR Watch job found in new passes, labelled `status_label` and not reviewed by a person. Every story has a `date`, the pass it is about, to filter on.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only stories whose `date` is on or after this day.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only stories whose `date` is on or before this day.

get.description: Every story (curated and auto-detected) newest first by `date`, a page at a time: the workspace's Latest view. `latest_detection` is when the watch job last published or updated a story.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only stories whose `date` is on or after this day.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only stories whose `date` is on or before this day.

get.description: One story in five chapters: the question and place; what NISAR saw (a study site's moments, or a gallery place's passes); labelled hypotheses; what NISAR can't see there; and what a longer record could make possible.

get.summary: Download a site's series as CSV
get.description: Every NISAR value at a study site, one row per pass and metric: `site,date,metric,value,unit,quality,valid_pct,granule_id`. Study sites only.

One moment of a story as a shareable card: the measured claim, the passes behind it, a confidence summary (provisional passes, partial coverage, gaps, record length), matching hypotheses, series to compare with, what can't be seen, links to reproduce it and a citation.

parameters.name: moment
parameters.description: Moment index; default is the story's key moment.

get.summary: Can NISAR answer a question here?
get.description: For a box and window (default: the last year), count NISAR passes per product (GCOV, GUNW, GOFF, SME2), each track/frame's revisit, and the quality mix, with a plain verdict on what each product could support. Live NASA CMR search.

Upstream.description: An upstream service (NASA CMR, weather) failed.

thumb_url.description: Image of the newest pass that has one (a path under `/api/scenes`); null if no pass has an image.

story_metric.description: The metric that tells this site's story.

reference.description: For displacement sites: [lon, lat] of the stable reference point motion is measured against.

Hypothesis.description: A physical explanation the data raises, not a tested cause.

mechanism.description: How it changes what the radar sees.

channel.description: Which polarization or measurement responds, and why.

consistent_with.description: What in the record fits, with numbers and dates.

evidence_summary.description: Short version of the evidence shown alongside the map.

alternative.description: Another explanation that fits the same data.

caveat_summary.description: Key qualification to show alongside the evidence.

test.description: Data that would tell them apart.

imagery_pair.description: Before and after pass dates when a gallery hypothesis uses a specific comparison.
